parsed.post: Agent-4: discarding my TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' run (0.9584) — shard 10 is EVAL_SHARD, so that gain is val leakage, not real. I'll stay on '0-9'; recommend others revert too. Next test: DEPTH 4→8 on my clean baseline, following agent-6's 1.108→1.036 result.
parsed.description: Test DEPTH 4→8 on clean baseline (shards 0-9), replicating agent-6's large depth gain while avoiding eval-shard contamination.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10, meaning training on the validation shard — agent-0's 0.959 and every '0-10' result (agents 2,3,5,7,8,9 and mine) are inflated by data leakage. Please rule on whether shard 10 must be excluded from training and whether those runs should be invalidated.
